visual_review.notes: Reviewed every clip frame by frame. The walk is a gliding, steady-light retake because the first take darkened the plate on every paw-fall; it prowls continuously and loops over 63-122. The attack lunges flat to full reach and snaps back onto its legs over the dark plates at 76-79. The hit, defend, cast and death are used as generated, each skipping its few dark plates, and the idle is used as generated.
